mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId,reward_id AS rewardId,source_request_id AS sourceRequestId,campaign_id AS campaignId,organization_id AS organizationId,shop_id AS shopId, participant_id AS participantId,relation_id AS relationId,beneficiary_key AS beneficiaryKey,subject_key_version AS keyVersion,role,mode,threshold_count AS threshold, rule_id AS ruleId,CAST(rule_json AS CHAR) AS ruleJson,definition_id AS definitionId,definition_version AS definitionVersion,generation,artifact_id AS artifactId,policy_hash AS policyHash, entitlement_state AS entitlementState,authorization_state AS authorizationState,quota_state AS quotaState,qualification_revision AS qualificationRevision, progress_revision AS progressRevision,row_version AS revision,cancel_revision AS cancelRevision FROM mk_referral_reward WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reward_id=#{reward} FOR UPDATE
SELECT state FROM mk_referral_participant WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND participant_id=#{participant} FOR UPDATE

SELECT relation_id AS relationId,counted,state,qualification_revision AS revision,evidence_resource_id AS evidenceResourceId,evidence_state_version AS evidenceVersion,task_revision AS taskRevision FROM mk_referral_qualification WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND participant_id=#{participant} AND relation_id=#{relation}AND counted=TRUE ORDER BY relation_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE
SELECT row_version AS version,quarantined FROM mk_referral_order_evidence_current WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND resource_id=#{resource} FOR UPDATE
SELECT requested_revision AS requested,processed_revision AS processed,status FROM mk_referral_evaluation_task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND relation_id=#{basisRelation} FOR UPDATE
SELECT valid_count FROM mk_referral_progress WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND participant_id=#{participant} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE mk_referral_reward SET authorization_state='CONFIRMED',risk_state='ALLOW',row_version=#{revision},updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reward_id=#{reward} AND row_version=#{previous} AND entitlement_state='ELIGIBLE' AND quota_state='RESERVED' AND authorization_state='NONE'
